tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for an element to appear or disappear on the page. Useful for waiting until page loads fully or loading spinners disappear.

selector.description: CSS selector, XPath, or webdriverio locator. Mutually exclusive with testing-library query fields.

text.description: Visible text content for testing-library getByText.

labelText.description: Label text associated with a form input for testing-library getByLabelText.

placeholderText.description: Input placeholder text for testing-library getByPlaceholderText.

displayValue.description: Current input display value for testing-library getByDisplayValue.

altText.description: Image alt attribute for testing-library getByAltText.

title.description: HTML title attribute for testing-library getByTitle.

name.description: Accessible name modifier (queryOptions.name) for role queries.

hidden.description: Include elements hidden from the accessibility tree (queryOptions.hidden).

disappear.description: Whether to wait for element to disappear. Default: false (wait for element to appear)

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds. Default: 3000

includeSnapshotInResponse.description: Whether to include page snapshot in response. Default: true

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture a DOM snapshot of the current page. Note: by default, not useful tags and attributes are excluded (e.g. script, style, etc.). Prefer to use defaults. Response contains info as to what was omitted. If you need more info, request a snapshot with more tags and attributes.

includeTags.description: HTML tags to include in the snapshot besides defaults

includeAttrs.description: HTML attributes to include in the snapshot besides defaults

excludeTags.description: HTML tags to exclude from the snapshot

excludeAttrs.description: HTML attributes to exclude from the snapshot

truncateText.description: Whether to truncate long text content (default: true)

maxTextLength.description: Maximum length of text content before truncation

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of the current browser viewport. Strongly prefer capturing text-based snapshots using takePageSnapshot tool. Only use to test for visual changes when text-based snapshots are not useful.

filePath.description: Path to save the screenshot (defaults to tmp directory)

tools.name: console
tools.description: Get browser-side console messages. This command only works with Chromium-based browsers and returns only "unseen" messages - those that were not returned by the previous getLogs call in the current session.

tools.name: list-tabs
tools.description: Get a list of all currently opened browser tabs with their URLs, titles, and active status

tools.name: switch-tab
tools.description: Switch to a specific browser tab by its number (starting from 1)

tabNumber.description: The number of the tab to switch to (starting from 1)

tools.name: new-tab
tools.description: Open a new browser tab, optionally navigate to a URL, and automatically switch to it

url.description: Optional URL to navigate to in the new tab

tools.name: close-tab
tools.description: Close a specific browser tab by its number (1-based), or close the current tab if no number is provided

tabNumber.description: The number of the tab to close (starting from 1). If not provided, closes the current tab

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Launch a new browser session with custom desired capabilities. Avoid using this tool unless the user explicitly requests a custom browser configuration; browsers are launched automatically for commands like navigate to URL. Testplane can ONLY download Chrome and Firefox automatically, for other browsers you MUST ensure that driver is launched and provide it as custom gridUrl.

headless.description: Whether to run browser in headless mode. When omitted, preserves the current session mode (CLI defaults to headless on first launch; use "--headless false" for headful mode).

desiredCapabilities.description: WebDriver desiredCapabilities that should be used when launching the browser. Example to launch Chrome with mobile emulation: {"browserName":"chrome","goog:chromeOptions":{"mobileEmulation":{"deviceMetrics":{"width":360,"height":800,"pixelRatio":1.0}}}}

gridUrl.description: WebDriver endpoint to connect to. "local" (default) lets Testplane manage Chrome and Firefox automatically; set a Selenium grid URL only when you need other browsers.

windowSize.description: Viewport to use for the session. Provide {"width": number, "height": number} or a string like "1280x720"; use null to reset to the default size.

tools.name: attach
tools.description: Attach to existing browser session

driverPid.description: Pid of webdriver process, need for close browser correct, necessarily provide it if it exist

browserName.description: Name of the browser being automated

session.description: Attach to browser json object from console after --keep-browser testplane run

tools.name: attach-repl
tools.description: Attach to a running Testplane REPL session

tools.name: close-browser
tools.description: Close the current browser session

tools.name: save-state
tools.description: Save the current browser state, including cookies and web storage, to a JSON file

path.description: Path to the JSON file with saved browser state. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.

cookies.description: Whether to include cookies in the saved state. Default: true

localStorage.description: Whether to include localStorage in the saved state. Default: true

sessionStorage.description: Whether to include sessionStorage in the saved state. Default: true

tools.name: restore-state
tools.description: Restore browser state from a JSON file. By default the page is refreshed after restore so it can observe restored cookies and web storage.

path.description: Path to the JSON file with saved browser state. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.

refresh.description: Whether to reload the current page after restoring state. Default: true. Reloading makes the page observe restored cookies and storage immediately.

tools.name: run-code
tools.description: Run arbitrary Testplane script using the current browser, useful when other tools don't provide the functionality you need. Inline input may be code or a function that receives browser as its only argument. In REPL sessions, the code is passed directly to the Testplane REPL.

code.description: JavaScript code to run. It may be an expression like "await browser.getUrl()" or a function like "(browser) => browser.getUrl()".

file.description: Path to a JavaScript file to run instead of inline code

tools.name: test-results
tools.description: Read a Testplane HTML report and list final-attempt test results with filters

report.description: Path or URL to a Testplane HTML report directory, report HTML file, or databaseUrls.json

limit.description: Maximum number of test results to print in text output. Default: 100, max: 500

offset.description: Number of matched test results to skip before listing in text output

grep.description: Regex to match against the full test name

status.description: Comma-separated status filter. Allowed: passed, failed, muted, retried, skipped. failed includes error and fail report statuses.

grepError.description: Regex to match against error text

meta.description: Meta filters in key=value form. Can be repeated

file.description: File path mask. Supports simple glob masks such as src/** or *.test.js

saveJson.description: Save the whole filtered report as JSON without pagination to a file under os.tmpdir()/testplane-cli, then print the path, summary, and example file fragment. Useful for saving output to a file for later interaction via scripts; saves the whole report instead of only the current page. Result fields are controlled by --fields.

fields.description: Comma-separated output fields for text and saved JSON. Allowed: status, browser, attempt, duration, file, name, error, meta, skipOrMuteReason. Default: status,browser,attempt,duration,file,name,error

tools.name: inspect-result
tools.description: Read a Testplane HTML report and inspect test result attempt details as JSON

report.description: Path or URL to a Testplane HTML report directory, report HTML file, or databaseUrls.json

attempt.description: Attempt index to inspect. When omitted, all attempts for the selected test and browser are returned

pretty.description: Pretty-print JSON output. Use --no-pretty for compact JSON

includeBase64.description: Include base64 image payloads in result images and errors. Omitted by default to keep output compact

tools.name: time-travel-snapshot
tools.description: Inspect Testplane Time Travel rrweb snapshot at a selected time and return a DOM snapshot of the replayed page, optionally with a diff from a previous time

report.description: Path or URL to a Testplane HTML report directory, report HTML file, or databaseUrls.json

name.description: Full test name to inspect in report mode

browser.description: Browser id to inspect in report mode

attempt.description: Attempt index to inspect. Defaults to the latest attempt for the selected test and browser

snapshotFile.description: Path or URL to a time travel snapshot zip. Mutually exclusive with report mode

time.description: Time to inspect in milliseconds. Values within snapshot duration are offsets from the first rrweb event; larger values are absolute timestamps

diffFrom.description: When set, return only current DOM nodes that changed between this time and the requested time. Uses the same offset/timestamp rules as time

includeTags.description: HTML tags to include in the snapshot besides defaults

includeAttrs.description: HTML attributes to include in the snapshot besides defaults

excludeTags.description: HTML tags to exclude from the snapshot

excludeAttrs.description: HTML attributes to exclude from the snapshot

truncateText.description: Whether to truncate long text content (default: true)

maxTextLength.description: Maximum length of text content before truncation

tools.name: time-travel-export-html
tools.description: Export a Testplane Time Travel rrweb snapshot at a selected time as a browser-openable HTML file with captured inline styles

report.description: Path or URL to a Testplane HTML report directory, report HTML file, or databaseUrls.json

name.description: Full test name to inspect in report mode

browser.description: Browser id to inspect in report mode

attempt.description: Attempt index to inspect. Defaults to the latest attempt for the selected test and browser

snapshotFile.description: Path or URL to a time travel snapshot zip. Mutually exclusive with report mode

time.description: Time to inspect in milliseconds. Values within snapshot duration are offsets from the first rrweb event; larger values are absolute timestamps

filePath.description: Path to save the exported HTML file. Defaults to os.tmpdir()/.testplane/time-travel-snapshots
